title: Share of primary energy that is low-carbon vs. GDP per capita
subtitle: Low-carbon energy is the sum of nuclear and renewable sources, measured as a percentage of [total energy supply](#dod:total-energy-supply). Gross domestic product (GDP) per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
